resources.string: openblockit uses this accessibility service only to keep you on the block screen when, during a session, you open an app that is not in your bag, so you cannot use other apps until the session ends. It does not read screen content.
Keeps the countdown visible while a session is active
Notifies you when a session is completed
Heads-up before an automatic routine session starts
An evening nudge if you have not done at least five minutes of session today
Alerts when the block protection is not working
